title: Add notify-obs deployment event step
description: Add a notify-obs step to the Woodpecker pipeline that emits a structured deployment event to uFawkesObs via OTEL Collector HTTP endpoint. Runs on main branch only, non-blocking, with DORA structured logging.

tasks.title: Add notify-obs step to .woodpecker.yml
tasks.description: Add a new step named notify-obs using curlimages/curl:latest. Position after upload-defectdojo. Has when: branch: main condition. Uses OTEL_ENDPOINT and OTEL_HEADERS from_secret. Commands POST OTEL deployment event JSON to ${OTEL_ENDPOINT}/v1/traces with required attributes (service.name, deployment.environment, deployment.version, deployment.status, git.commit.sha, git.branch, pipeline.duration_ms). Non-blocking (|| true). DORA structured JSON logging at start and end.
acceptance: Step named 'notify-obs' exists in .woodpecker.yml steps list
Step has when: condition with branch: main
Commands POST to ${OTEL_ENDPOINT}/v1/traces with JSON payload
DORA structured JSON logging at step start
DORA structured JSON logging at step end
